faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Hyderabad Project Research Scientist – I (Non-Medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Project Research Scientist – I (Non-Medical) position at IIT Hyderabad is 03 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Research Scientist – I (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist – I (Non-Medical) position at IIT Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in ultrasound with at least 2 years of expertise in ultrasound imaging and beamforming. Expertise in microswimmers is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist – I (Non-Medical) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 70,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email to the designated email address provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any category.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Research Scientist – I (Non-Medical) position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an email application, followed by shortlisting, and a personal interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job type position at IIT Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Hyderabad located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad is located in Hyderabad, Telangana.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from any state apply for this position?
faq.answer: The notification is for IIT Hyderabad, which is in Telangana. Candidates from all eligible backgrounds are encouraged to apply, provided they meet the qualification criteria.
